summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Industrial production of beverages and antibiotics uses closed fermentors. Brewer's yeast synthesizes ethanol from malted cereals and fruit juices. Non-distilled beverages have lower alcohol (<14%) because yeast dies of alcohol toxicity; distillation yields higher concentrations (40-50%). Penicillin was discovered by Fleming and developed into an antibiotic by Florey and Chain (1945 Nobel Prize).

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 3.1 Industrial Alcoholic Fermentation
- **Brewer's Yeast (*Saccharomyces cerevisiae*)**: Ferments sugars in fruit juices (grapes) and malted cereals (barley) under anaerobic conditions in large closed **Fermentors / Bioreactors**:
  $$\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 \xrightarrow{\text{Zymase}} 2\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH} + 2\text{CO}_2$$
- **Beverage Classification by Distillation**:
  1. **Non-Distilled Beverages**: **Wine** ($10\text{--}14\%$ alcohol) and **Beer** ($4\text{--}8\%$ alcohol) are bottled directly without distillation. Natural fermentation ceases when alcohol reaches $\approx 13\%$ because high ethanol concentrations are toxic to yeast cells.
  2. **Distilled Beverages**: **Whisky, Brandy, and Rum** ($40\text{--}50\%$ alcohol) are produced by distilling the fermented wash, concentrating ethanol and volatile congeners.

### 3.2 Discovery & Clinical Production of Penicillin
- **Alexander Fleming (1928)**: Discovered Penicillin serendipitously while working with *Staphylococcus aureus* culture plates. Fleming observed a clear zone of inhibition (halo) surrounding a contaminating blue-green mold, identified as ***Penicillium notatum***.
- **Howard Florey & Ernst Chain (1940s)**: Established the biochemical isolation, purification, and clinical antibiotic efficacy of Penicillin in treating bacterial infections in wounded Allied soldiers during World War II.
- **1945 Nobel Prize in Medicine**: Awarded jointly to **Alexander Fleming, Ernst Boris Chain, and Sir Howard Walter Florey**.
- **Superbugs & Antibiotic Resistance**: Indiscriminate over-prescription of antibiotics has selected for resistant bacterial strains like Methicillin-Resistant *Staphylococcus aureus* (MRSA) and Multi-Drug Resistant *Mycobacterium tuberculosis* (MDR-TB).

conceptBreakdown.heading: Continuous vs Batch Culture in Bioreactors
conceptBreakdown.title: Continuous vs Batch Culture in Bioreactors
conceptBreakdown.content: Batch fermentation is a closed system where nutrient depletion and toxic metabolite accumulation limit growth; Continuous-flow culture continuously adds fresh sterile nutrient medium while removing spent broth to maintain cells in constant exponential log phase.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Other Clinical Antibiotics
conceptBreakdown.title: Other Clinical Antibiotics
conceptBreakdown.content: Actinomycetes (genus Streptomyces) produce over 70% of clinical antibiotics, including Streptomycin (Streptomyces griseus - discovered by Selman Waksman), Tetracycline, Erythromycin, and Chloramphenicol.
